title: Small bias output bit
statement: Let $\ell>0$, let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ be given, and choose vectors $r,s\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$. For $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the output bit as the binary dot product of $s$ with the $i+1$-st power of $r$ modulo the implementation's monic irreducible polynomial.
hypotheses_covered: a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$
